method: Original face tags retained through Boolean union/difference; actual per-face colors, no image textures.

rules.name: Neutral unverified closures
rules.note: Opaque room filling and hidden surfaces are model simplifications, not observed material.

rules.name: Separately modeled ground supports and through-passage
rules.note: Asymmetric west/east room blocks, north projections, offset core and oval foyer mass. No copied rooftop extrusion; no interior stair reconstruction.

rules.name: Whole twelve-numbered-level envelope
rules.note: Complete four-sided body; 12 numbered levels, not occupancy. Dimensions normalized, unsurveyed. Upper court-side projection interpolated within observed bounds.

rules.name: South paired waving bands and glazing
rules.note: Offset western eye and lower middle entry wave, rounded short-end returns. Counts and widths simplified for display.

rules.name: Open recessed reflective eye with closed back
rules.note: Concave faceted silver recess, not blue painted disk and not a full-building tunnel. Depth and curvature approximate.

rules.name: Court side vertical service screens and curved bands
rules.note: Observed lower screen rhythm; upper unseen rhythm is an explicitly bounded extrapolation. No mirrored south eye.

rules.name: Unequal short ends
rules.note: Horizontal bands turn rounded corners; east broad glazing and west narrower neutral groups differ; obscured openings simplified.

rules.name: Roof outline distinct from ground and raised screen
rules.note: Roof/court projection is mildly undulating; high screen is a separate continuous long double-lobed enclosure. Not two detached elliptical towers.

rules.name: Three main PV fields plus south long strip
rules.note: 2022 visible distribution; panel subdivisions and low mounting height are model simplification, not panel count or HVAC evidence.

rules.name: Small own base and landing
rules.note: Manufacturing base bounded to own envelope; not a full court, street network, A1 or A3.
